Apply a kernel to a column.

Convolves one numeric column with the kernel, zero-phase (centred; the rows beyond the ends repeat the edge value), and adds the result as &lt;column>_filtered beside every input column.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Signal](../categories/signal.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `Convolution1D` |
| Search words | convolution, 1d, signal, filter, kernel, moving average |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Data** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input table containing the signal column |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Convolved** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input table plus &lt;signal_col>_filtered |

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| signal_col | `signal_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Numeric signal column. Required. |
| kernel | `kernel` | Text | `0.25,0.5,0.25` |   | The run | Required comma-separated finite kernel taps. Required. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | Yes; the result can be saved as a table |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
